theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_cube_poincare
theorems.statement: ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (V : ℝ), (∀ y, ∃ z : ℤ, u y = z) → IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V) → ∃ β : ℤ, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |u y - β| ≤ c * V ∧ |(β : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |u y|
